clues: This city sits right in the heart of its land. Its ground is a tract set up just for the seat of rule.
The year here swings between a warm, humid rainy season and a blazing dry season. In between, dusty harmattan winds fill the air with haze.
On 12 Dec 1991, this city took the top job from Lagos. Lagos was the place with the most folk in all the land.
One single giant rock, carved by water long ago, defines this city's view. Its big government buildings spread out at the rock's feet.
Nigeria is run from this town, and its work of state is done here. The top team that leads the land has its base in this place.
